reviews.review: I'm sad that this is one of the few good Alien games. I really love the series, and would love a version of this game in first person. Like, Aliens: Colonial Marines but not boring and broken. Don't get me wrong, there's issues too with this game. But I guess the bar is set so low that this is a good enough game.
A very soldi, capable Alien Co-op shooter. This is especially true if you understand the hurdles the developer overcame to get the game to where it is.

Repetitive, rushed and uninmaginative. At times glitchy. Expected way more from the story and single player. It's basically a co-op grind shooter, that's it. Imo Not worth the time, let alone the money. The soundtrack is SUBLIME tho, too bad it wasn't used for an epic single player immersion experience.

It's a good game that helps expand the Aliens franchise, a solid 8/10.

Pros:
1. The different classes are unique and mostly well-rounded, I've only played as 4 of the 7 though.
2. The story is excellent and adds to the franchise both in the main game and the DLC.
3. It has really cathartic moments where you have hordes of Xenomorphs coming at you and you get to wipe them out, especially as the Phalanx and Demolisher classes. There are also game modes that achieve this and are fun to play.

Cons
1. Higher difficulties don't favor solo players, your computer Synth teammates aren't much help at the Extreme & Insane levels. Even the Challenge cards offer little help so you have to play with others.
2. I would have liked for there to be either a longer campaign or multiple campaigns to play since you are on a ship going out on patrol and checking up on issues with colonies. Having multiple planets with a Xenomorphs issue I think would've added a lot more substance to the game. The Pathogen DLC was a good start, but I would've liked more.
3. The fire team being limited to 3 people is frustrating, especially if you want to play with friends. This also contributes to my issue of the Synths being weak at the higher levels.
This is a good Aliens game...though I love them all.
